 Hon'Ble Mr Justice Javed Iqbal Wani, Judge

1. During the consideration of the instant appeal filed by the appellant herein under the provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, against the award dated 19.12.2017 passed by the MACT Pulwama (for short the Tribunal) in claim petition titled as ""Gulzar Ahmad Dandroo Vs. Nisar Ahmad Lone and Ors."

sentences.text:
on 17.07.2023 the appearing counsel for the appellant had invited the attention of this Court to the driving license of the driver of offending vehicle bearing No. JKE-5254 who had caused the vehicular accident on 14.07.2006 to show that the said license produced by the driver of the said offending vehicle before the Tribunal had been renewed w.e.f 25.09.1999 upto 24.10.2002 and was not renewed on the date of accident being 14.07.2006 and the Tribunal wrongly recorded a finding in the impugned Award despite the aforesaid fact that the license in question stands renewed up till 12.01.2009, thus, necessitating the production of original license for perusal and examination of this Court as a consequence whereof, the appearing counsel for the owner of the offending vehicle being New India Assurance Company Ltd Through vs Gulzar Ahmad Dandroo on 6 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32855301/
1 respondent 3 herein came to be directed to produce the original license of the driver so that the issue involved in the matter is settled.
2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Today the counsel for the respondent 3 herein however, expresses his inability to produce the said license on account of non cooperation of the driver respondent 2 herein.
Be that as it may, the Court under these circumstances is left with no option but to test the validity of the Award under challenge on merits.

3. Facts giving rise to the filing of instant appeal would reveal that a claim petition in terms of Act of 1988 came to be filed by respondent 1 herein for compensation for the injuries sustained by him in a vehicular accident caused by the vehicle bearing registration No. JKE- 5254 owned by respondent 3 herein and driven by respondent 2 herein.

The Tribunal after entertaining the claim petition summoned the respondents in response to which, the respondents appeared and filed their written responses thereto and on the basis of the said pleadings of the parties the Tribunal framed following issues: -
(i) Whether on 14.07.2006, while the petitioner was waiting for bus at Awantipora was hit by vehicle bearing No. JKE-5254 which was being driven by respondent No. 1 in rash and negligent manner which has caused compound fracture in both the legs of the petitioner and has rendered him permanently disabled ?
OPP (ii) Whether the petitioner is entitled to compensation under MV Act, if so, to what extent and from whom?

OPP. 
(iii) Whether on the day of occurrence respondent No. 1 was not having valid and effective DL and RP, if so, what would be its effect on the claim petition?
OPR 4.

Insofar as the issues 1 and 2 are concerned onus whereof to prove had been put on the claimant, the claimant besides appearing as his own witness in the witness box also examined two witnesses namely Imtiyaz Ahmad Dar, Dr. Abid Hussain Koka whereas in order to prove the issue 3, onus whereof to prove was put on the Insurance Company appellant herein, it examined one witness namely Irshad Ahmad Bhat being Legal Assistant of the Company, whereafter the Tribunal passed the impugned award fixing the liability upon the Insurance Company appellant herein to pay compensation to the claimant respondent 1 herein.

5. The Insurance Company appellant herein has challenged the impugned Award in the instant appeal fundamentally on the ground that the Tribunal did not consider the evidence led by it qua the issue 3 whereunder the Insurance Company proved the fact that the driver of the offending vehicle was not holding a valid and effective license on the date of accident and also that the fitness certificate of the offending vehicle was not valid on the date of the accident and that the Tribunal while passing the impugned Award wrongly opined that the Insurance Company appellant failed to New India Assurance Company Ltd Through vs Gulzar Ahmad Dandroo on 6 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32855301/
2 prove issue 3 or to produce anything on record.

entities.text: New India Assurance Company Ltd Through vs Gulzar Ahmad Dandroo
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Perusal of the record available on the file as also the examination of the original record of the Tribunal reveals that the above named witness of the Insurance Company namely Irshad Ahmad Bhat appeared as a witness on 04.07.2012 and had deposed that after receiving a copy of the claim petition in question, the Company conducted a verification whereupon it surfaced that the driving license of the driver of the offending vehicle was not a valid on the date of accident and also the fitness certificate of the offending vehicle was not valid as well on the date of accident.
The said witness on the date of his examination had also produced photocopies of the documents thereof which had been taken on record by the Tribunal.
Further the said witness had been cross examined as well by the counsel for the claimant respondent 1 herein..

7. In presence of the aforesaid fact that the Insurance Company appellant herein have had produced above named witness before the Tribunal in order to discharge the onus put on it for proving the issue 3, it can safely be said that the Tribunal grossly erred while observing and opining that the Insurance Company appellant herein failed to produce anything on record.

The said issue thus,
cannot, but, be said to have been addressed appropriately by the Tribunal therefore, necessitating the remanding of the matter back to the Tribunal for its reconsideration.
8.

Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and without disturbing the finding qua issues 1 and 2, the Tribunal is directed to reconsider and revisit the issue 3 in accordance with law and pass appropriate orders thereof
however, before proceeding further in the matter as directed above, the Tribunal shall summon the respondent 1 as also the respondent 2 herein.

9. Parties to appear before the Tribunal on 20.05.2024.
10.
Disposed of.
(JAVED IQBAL WANI) JUDGE SRINAGAR 06.05.2024
